name: Gintsuki no Onmyouji
source:
A modern day exorcist tends to the evil spirits that balance our universe. Her name is Arisa Kujo.

It wasn't meant to be like this - she was just another girl with a love for urban myths. But then one day she fell from the rooftop, and that experience changed everything.

Intense occult schoolgirl ADV legend!

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE078779.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
九条亚里沙是活跃于现代的驱魔师，负责处理维系世界平衡的邪灵。

事情原本不该如此——她曾经只是一个喜爱都市传说的普通女孩。直到某天，她从屋顶坠落，那段经历改变了一切。

紧张刺激的女高中生灵异冒险传奇！

[译自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE078779.html]DLsite English[/url]]
